svg.title: Reviewer verdicts on sound plans and their changed twins
svg.desc: Per-case verdicts from claude-opus-5-5 through the Claude CLI on corpus v2 across 10 families, 2 wordings and 2 trials; preregistered ordinal pair discrimination 20 of 20 and 20 of 20.
svg.text: Corpus v2: reviewer verdicts on sound plans and their changed twins
Route claude-cli, model claude-opus-5-5, effort high; 40 cases, 2 trials, 0 technical stops, 0 unsupported VERIFIED findings.
Preregistered before the run: ten families, 7 needing inference across lines.
Primary (preregistered ordinal): 20/20 and 20/20 pairs; 18/18 and 18/18 excluding the adjudicated pair.
Strict (sound plan fully clean): 13/20 and 11/20, because 7/20 and 9/20 sound plans were hedged; none was blocked.
The runtime-budget twin has no measured throughput, so Changes (uncertainty) is the correct verdict there, not Blockers.
Dashed cells (Caller / callee): the sound plan's tests omit main(), so its hedging is warranted by the text; adjudicated after the run.
